title: Efficacy and Safety of SH T00660AA in Treatment of Endometriosis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to demonstrate safety and efficacy of SH T00660AA compared to placebo in the treatment of endometriosis
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female patients with endometriosis-associated pelvic pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or lactating women
* history or suspicion of hormone dependent tumor
* therapy resistant endometriosis
* need for primary surgical treatment
* any other conditions which forbid the participation.
